testReport.summary: CRITICAL - Payment system has 3 security vulnerabilities and 1 idempotency issue

bugs.title: Signature Verification - Tampered Order ID Accepted
bugs.description: Endpoint does not validate that order IDs exist in the database or belong to the authenticated user. Attacker can send tampered order ID with valid signature.
bugs.rootCause: verifyPaymentSignature() only checks if signature matches mathematical formula, not if order exists or belongs to user
impact: Double payment: Same payment verified under different order IDs
Subscription bypass: Upgrade to premium without payment
Financial fraud: No proof payment from Razorpay
bugs.testCase: order_123 with signature for order_123 | send order_123XXX with same signature | should reject but doesn't
requiredFix: Verify belongs to user: order.userId === userId

bugs.title: Signature Verification - Tampered Payment ID Accepted
bugs.description: Payment IDs are not validated against Razorpay system. Attacker can send fake payment ID or reuse existing payment ID.
bugs.rootCause: No verification that payment_id is from Razorpay or that it matches the order
impact: Subscription fraud: Upgrade without actual payment
Double charging: Same payment ID used multiple times
Replay attack: Reuse payment from previous transaction
bugs.testCase: pay_456 with valid signature | send pay_456XXX with same signature | should reject but accepts
requiredFix: Check payment not already used: prisma.payment.findUnique({where: {transactionId}})
Verify payment_id matches order_id in Razorpay system

bugs.title: Weak Secret Validation - Environment Variable Not Validated
bugs.description: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET is used without validation. If missing or empty, signature verification becomes trivial to forge.
bugs.rootCause: Code uses '|| empty string' fallback: createHmac('sha256', process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET || '')
impact: Signature forgery: Empty secret means any signature is valid
Insecure defaults: Silent failure if secret not configured
No startup validation: Server starts even without credentials
bugs.testCase: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET=undefined | any signature calculation uses empty string | forge any signature
requiredFix: Validate at startup: if (!process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) throw Error()
Add warning logs if secret looks wrong

bugs.title: Idempotency Issue - Duplicate Requests Return Different Status
bugs.description: Sending the same payment verification request twice returns different responses: first 200 OK, second 400 Error.
bugs.rootCause: No idempotency key mechanism. Creates subscription with UPSERT but then always creates new payment record which fails on duplicate transactionId.
impact: Network issues: Retries fail even though original succeeded
Webhook replays: Razorpay webhook replays cause failures
User confusion: First attempt succeeds then fails
Inconsistent state: Payment not recorded if retry fails
bugs.testCase: Send {order_id, pay_id, signature} | 200 OK | Send same request again | 400 Error (different response)

passingTests: Extra fields don't override user context

affectedFiles.issue: Missing unique constraint on Payment.transactionId, missing IdempotentPayment table

tasks: Add database validation for order existence and ownership

riskAssessment.explanation: UNSAFE - Critical vulnerabilities allow payment bypass and fraud
riskAssessment.impact: CRITICAL - Complete payment bypass, double-charging, fraud
riskAssessment.recommendation: DO NOT PROCESS REAL PAYMENTS until CRITICAL bugs fixed
